name: hip_hop
description: Modern hip-hop / trap. Massive sub-bass (808s), scooped lower mids, bright top for snare crack and hi-hat. Heavy limiting and saturation are part of the aesthetic.
sources: iZotope Tonal Balance Control 3 reference curve naming (Hip-Hop / Trap / Classic Hip-Hop)
Streaming mastering guides 2025: hip-hop target -8 LUFS integrated typical
Calibrated: modern_rock baseline + hip-hop spectral shifts (sub +4, mids -1.5, air +2.5)
calibration_note: Tonal balance targets are wideband band-RMS at integrated_target LUFS. Hip-hop has dramatically more sub content and scooped mids vs rock.
